task:
Complete the Python/PostgreSQL driver end-state on the existing V3 integration branch. Start from the exact selected target branch and preserve its existing #601 scope/history. This supersedes the temporary Python 3.12 legacy-tooling quarantine added by run 34029699738: remove that quarantine by porting the underlying importer/tooling paths rather than keeping a permanent 3.12 exception. Do not deploy, access production, mutate production data, change DNS/credentials, or authorise schema/destructive changes.

Implement the end state comprehensively across active/current code and configuration. At minimum audit and fix: root pyproject Python requirement/classifiers/Ruff target; all current GitHub workflow setup-python selections and labels including CI canonical/tooling lanes, Semgrep and any other active Python job; apps/importer and apps/eddn Dockerfiles; apps/maintenance Dockerfile/runtime so it has an explicit 3.14 Python authority and no py3-psycopg2 package; Windows bootstrap/doctor scripts; OpenAPI/type-generation Python launcher fallbacks; current operational/developer docs that still prescribe 3.11/3.12; importer dependency authority; root test dependency authority; all active synchronous DB imports/usages in apps/importer, scripts/checks, repair/reconcile/release/admin/tooling and shared executable paths. The already-ported scripts/checks/data_invariants.py must remain Psycopg 3.

For Psycopg 3, correctly port semantics rather than doing textual renames: use psycopg / psycopg.sql, psycopg.rows.dict_row or equivalent where dict rows are required, Psycopg 3 exception classes, correct transaction/autocommit behavior, and replace psycopg2.extras helpers such as RealDictCursor/execute_values with Psycopg 3-supported cursor executemany/COPY or another behavior-preserving implementation as appropriate. Preserve bulk-write safety contracts, SQL composition safety, row-count/rollback behavior and existing tests. Pin a Python-3.14-compatible Psycopg 3 binary distribution consistently (prefer the existing V3 authority psycopg[binary]==3.3.4 unless repository constraints require a justified equivalent). Remove active dependencies/packages/imports for psycopg2-binary, psycopg2, py3-psycopg2 and types-psycopg2. Historical prose/evidence may remain only where it is genuinely historical and cannot be mistaken for current authority.

Remove/rename the temporary `legacy-tooling` Python 3.12 CI lane and fold its importer/canonical tests into explicit CPython 3.14 validation. Add regression tests/static contract checks that fail if active workflows, Dockerfiles, project config or dev launchers select Python 3.11/3.12, or if active dependency/source paths reintroduce psycopg2; those guards must explicitly allow only genuinely historical evidence/irrelevant package-version substrings and must assert apps/api still owns asyncpg. Validate with actual CPython 3.14, focused unit/integration tests for migrated synchronous DB behavior, importer/canonical safety tests, lint/static contracts, Docker/workflow contract tests as practical, apps/api `uv sync --frozen` / lock integrity, and any existing V3 stack decision tests. Use parallel agents for independent porting/audit work if useful. End with an exact list of remaining 3.11/3.12 and psycopg2 string hits and classify each; the implementation is not complete if any hit is an active authority/executable/dependency. Do not commit or push; wrapper handles that.
